# Recorded model games

Game logs with every model reply recorded, for the TypeScript conversion's parity check (`docs/CONVERSION-PLAN.md`:
"Model games are part of parity through their logs"). Replaying them makes no API calls. Copied from `sim/runs/` on
Haakon's computer on 26 October 2026; checked then for API keys, e-mail addresses, local paths and the isolation test's
canary words, and none were found. Git stores them with LF line endings; the text is unchanged.

| File | Game |
| --- | --- |
| `second-simulation-seed-7.jsonl` | The second agent simulation (build order item 4), seed 7: model kings and model characters |
| `second-simulation-seed-15.jsonl` | The same, seed 15 |
| `first-simulation-sleep-on-seed-7.jsonl` | The first agent simulation, sleeping seats on: model kings, script characters |
